title: Sources: Apple is discussing multiyear content deals with publishers to deliver current news and information for Siri AI, with a potential nine-figure budget (Alexandra Bruell/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Alexandra Bruell / Wall Street Journal: Sources: Apple is discussing multiyear content deals with publishers to deliver current news and information for Siri AI, with a potential nine-figure budget — The content deals could provide the tech company's voice assistant with current news and information
